I solved level 1 in 20 actions. The human baseline is 26.

How the level works:
- There are two plus shapes, one 9 plus and one b plus, and each colour has four matching target squares.
- The 9 plus starts selected. Each move shifts the selected plus by 3 cells.
- The goal is to move each plus so its arms cross the centers of all four targets of its colour. Putting the plus center at the middle point of those four targets does this.
- Action 5 switches control from the 9 plus to the b plus.

My moves:
1. I moved the 9 plus up 7 times and right 4 times, to (48,24). Its arms then crossed all four 9 targets.
2. I pressed 5. I moved the b plus left 2 times and up 5 times, to near (15,12). The level completed then.
